title: Alnus Serrulata
text: This remedy is indicated in cases of skin diseases and glandular disorders. It is useful in cases of eczema and chronic inflammation of the mucous membranes. There is a general tendency to enlarged glands and a feeling of debility. Eczema, with much itching and burning. Scabby eruptions. Impetigo. Enlarged glands in the neck and other parts of the body. Leucorrhoea. Amenorrhoea. Compare: Calcarea carbonica; Mercurius; Sulphur. Tincture to third potency.
